scene: {CAT} in the desert on one side, {HOUSECAT} on a velvet sofa on the other

text: that once stole mice from a mud-brick granary
scene: {CAT} in the dark granary with a mouse in its mouth

text: now have job titles,
scene: {HOUSECAT} sitting behind a little office desk with a nameplate

text: fan clubs,
scene: crowds of fans holding up signs with a cat's face on them

text: and their own birthday cakes.
scene: {HOUSECAT} in a party hat in front of a fish-shaped birthday cake with a candle

text: And somewhere in the world right now,
scene: the Earth at night with tiny lights in the windows of houses

text: a grown adult is spending a ridiculous amount of money
scene: {GUY} at a pet store checkout with a huge cart full of cat toys and a long receipt

text: on a giant cat tower
scene: {GUY} building a huge, tall carpeted cat tower in his apartment

text: only for the cat to sit in the cardboard box it came in.
scene: {HOUSECAT} happily sitting in an empty cardboard box, ignoring the giant cat tower behind it

text: But here's the part I really want to leave you with.
scene: {GUY} sitting on a chair, facing the viewer, calm and serious

text: Because the more you look at this story,
scene: a magnifying glass moving across a long timeline

text: the stranger it gets.
scene: the timeline twisting into a spiral

text: In almost every other case of domestication,
scene: a farm with cows, sheep, horses and goats inside fences

text: humans were clearly in charge.
scene: {CAVE} holding a rope tied to a cow, pulling it, a little crown on his head

text: We captured animals.
scene: {CAVE} throwing a net over a wild goat

text: We fenced them in.
scene: sheep behind a wooden fence looking bored

text: We bred them for meat,
scene: a cow standing in a field

text: milk,
scene: a goat being milked into a clay bowl

text: wool,
scene: a sheep being sheared, wool flying

text: and work.
scene: a horse pulling a wooden plow across a field

text: But cats?
scene: {HOUSECAT} sitting alone in the middle of the farm, outside of every fence

text: We never fenced them in.
scene: {HOUSECAT} jumping easily over a tall wooden fence

text: We never really needed them for meat or milk.
scene: a crossed-out milk bottle and a crossed-out piece of meat next to the cat

text: And for most of history, we didn't even control who they had kittens with.
scene: {HOUSECAT} sneaking out at night over a garden wall, a tomcat waiting on the other side under the moon

text: Cats chose us.
scene: {CAT} walking toward a village by its own choice, the village glowing warmly

text: They moved into our villages on their own terms.
scene: {CAT} carrying a tiny bag into a mud-brick hut, looking confident

text: They changed their behavior just enough to get what they wanted.
scene: {CAT} acting cute for {CAVE} while secretly holding a fish behind its back

text: And they kept everything else.
scene: {HOUSECAT} with a wild shadow on the wall behind it showing sharp claws and teeth

text: Their wild instincts.
scene: {HOUSECAT} stalking a toy mouse in a living room in full hunting pose

text: Their independence.
scene: {HOUSECAT} walking away from {GUY} who is holding out his arms for a hug

text: Their freedom to just walk away.
scene: {HOUSECAT} walking out of an open door into a sunny garden

text: In fact, cats are so good at being wild
scene: {HOUSECAT} creeping through a garden in hunting pose

text: that scientists consider them one of the most destructive invasive predators in the world.
scene: a world map with red warning icons and cat silhouettes on many islands

text: Outdoor cats in the United States alone
scene: a map of the United States with cat icons scattered everywhere

text: are estimated to kill more than a billion birds every year.
scene: a huge pile of feathers next to a satisfied {HOUSECAT}, birds fleeing in the sky

text: That sweet thing purring on your lap
scene: {HOUSECAT} purring sweetly on {GUY}'s lap

text: is still, technically, one of nature's most efficient hunters.
scene: the same cat's shadow on the wall shaped like a roaring lion

text: And some scientists even wonder
scene: {SCI} at a desk with a thoughtful face, a light bulb flickering above

text: if cats have been changing us in ways we haven't fully understood yet.
scene: a human head silhouette with a tiny cat sitting inside the brain at a control desk

text: There's a tiny parasite called Toxoplasma
scene: a cute cartoon microscopic parasite with a little smile, seen through a microscope lens

text: that reproduces inside cats.
scene: the parasite waving from inside a cartoon cat's belly

text: Infected rats can lose their fear of cat smell.
scene: a rat walking happily toward a cat, with hearts instead of fear, the cat licking its lips

text: And a huge number of humans carry it too,
scene: a crowd of people with tiny parasite icons floating above some of their heads

text: usually without any obvious symptoms.
scene: {GUY} shrugging, smiling, a tiny parasite on his shoulder waving

text: Some studies have linked it to small changes in human behavior,
scene: {SCI} looking at a brain scan with a few highlighted spots

text: though the evidence is still debated.
scene: two scientists arguing in front of a whiteboard with question marks

text: But think about how wild that question is.
scene: {GUY} with his head exploding into colorful sparkles

text: Think about the whole chain of events.
scene: a long chain of icons connected by arrows, glowing one by one

text: Humans started storing grain.
scene: {CAVE} putting grain into a clay pot

text: The grain attracted mice.
scene: mice running toward the clay pot

text: The mice attracted wildcats.
scene: {CAT} running toward the mice

text: And the wildcats found humans.
scene: {CAT} sitting on the clay pot looking at {CAVE}

text: A tiny accident of farming
scene: a single grain of wheat glowing in a big hand

text: created one of the strangest friendships in history.
scene: {CAVE} and {CAT} sitting together by the fire under the stars, shown from behind

text: We spent ten thousand years thinking we domesticated cats.
scene: {CAVE} proudly holding a cat, with a "WINNER" medal on his chest

text: Maybe they were negotiating with us the whole time.
scene: {HOUSECAT} and {CAVE} sitting across a table, signing a contract, the cat holding the pen

text: That wildcat
scene: {CAT} sitting on the grain pot in the dark storehouse, eyes glowing green

text: that sat on a grain pot ten thousand years ago,
scene: the dark storehouse in warm torchlight, {CAVE} in the doorway

text: staring at a farmer with a torch,
scene: {CAVE} slowly lowering his torch and his spear, his face softening

text: wasn't asking for permission.
scene: {CAT} looking calm and confident, not afraid at all

text: It was making an offer.
scene: {CAT} holding out a dead mouse toward {CAVE} like a gift

text: I'll protect your food.
scene: {CAT} standing guard in front of the grain pots, mice running away

text: You leave me alone.
scene: {CAVE} walking away and closing the door gently, {CAT} sitting on the pot satisfied

text: Deal?
scene: {CAT} and {CAVE} shaking hand and paw, golden light around them

text: And amazingly,
scene: the scene morphing, the mud-brick hut slowly turning into a modern apartment

text: we're still living under that deal today.
scene: {GUY} on a couch, {HOUSECAT} on the back of the couch, both looking at the viewer

text: So the next time your cat wakes you up at five in the morning,
scene: {GUY} in bed at night, the clock showing 5:00, {HOUSECAT} sitting on his face

text: or knocks something off the table just to watch you react,
scene: {HOUSECAT} pushing a glass off a table, looking right at {GUY}

text: or slowly blinks at you from across the room,
scene: {HOUSECAT} across the living room slowly blinking, soft light from a window

text: just remember.
scene: {GUY} smiling softly, looking at his cat

text: That is a desert hunter
scene: a ghostly image of {CAT} in the desert appearing behind {HOUSECAT}

text: who walked into a human village ten thousand years ago,
scene: {CAT} walking into a mud-brick village at sunset

text: looked at us,
scene: {CAT} looking at {CAVE} with big round eyes

text: and decided we were worth keeping.
scene: {CAT} curling up in {CAVE}'s lap by the fire, both falling asleep

text: We didn't tame cats.
scene: {GUY} shaking his head with a smile

text: Cats agreed to live with us.
scene: {HOUSECAT} sleeping on {GUY}'s chest on the couch, both peaceful

text: And honestly,
scene: {GUY} gently petting the sleeping cat

text: we got the better end of the deal.
scene: {GUY} and {HOUSECAT} sitting at the window together looking at the sunset, warm golden light
